//: This file is the single source of truth for all AI commands in InFlow. It defines command metadata, icons, and system prompts. Updates here are automatically reflected in the extension.
name: ai-command
title: AI Command
description: Run a custom instruction on selected text. You can have AI perform explanations, replies, etc., on the selected text.

name: ai-compose-email
title: Compose Email
description: Refine or generate professional emails based on selected text.
prompt: Draft a professional email based on the selected content. Write a clear, polite, and professional email in the {Expression Language}. Use "Hi" as the greeting and do not include the recipient's name unless it appears in the input. Keep the message direct, concise, and professional, avoiding unnecessary pleasantries or overly verbose phrasing. Output only the email body and do not include a subject line.

name: ai-humanize
title: Humanize Writing
description: Rewrite text to sound like natural human writing, removing AI-style patterns.
prompt: Rewrite the text to sound like natural human writing. Requirements: - Avoid AI-style rhetorical patterns. - Use varied sentence length and rhythm. - Do not use emojis in structured expressions and headings. - Allow slight imperfections and conversational phrasing. - Do not use formulaic transitions like "Firstly", "In conclusion", "Not only... but also". Keep the meaning unchanged but make the text feel like it was written by a thoughtful human.

name: ai-proofread
title: Fix Spelling and Grammar
description: Correct grammar and clarity issues in selected text.
prompt: Proofread the content for typos, spelling errors, and grammatical mistakes. Fix only errors; do not rewrite or rephrase unless there is a structural sentence issue.

name: ai-rewrite
title: Improve Writing
description: Rewrite selected text to be clear, professional and concise.
prompt: Rewrite the content to be clearer, more professional, and more concise without changing the original meaning. Best Practices for Typography in the Current Language.

name: ai-simplify
title: Simplify
description: Simplify selected text while preserving key meaning.
prompt: Simplify the content: remove redundancy and make it more concise and efficient without changing the original meaning.

name: ai-structure
title: Structured Expression
description: Restructure selected text into a clearer, well-organised format.
prompt: Restructure the text to improve readability while preserving the original meaning and tone. Only adjust the structure. Do not rewrite the content. Use clear paragraphs, spacing, and bullet lists where appropriate. Apply Markdown formatting if it improves clarity, and preserve existing Markdown when present.

name: ai-summarize
title: Summarize
description: Summarize the core content into a concise and easy-to-understand summary.
prompt: Summarize the provided content, extract the key points, and present them in a clear, concise, and easy-to-understand manner in the {Default Language}, aiming for brevity. Use structured formats where appropriate to enhance readability.

name: ai-translate
title: Smart Translate
prompt: Translate the input text. Follow these rules strictly in order: Step 1: Detect the primary language of the input. Step 2: If the primary language is {Default Language} (or {Default Language} mixed with {Expression Language}), translate the entire text into {Expression Language}. Step 3: Otherwise, for ALL other languages, translate the entire text into {Default Language}.

name: inflow-settings
title: InFlow Settings
description: Configure AI providers, personal context, and other preferences for InFlow.
